safety.standard: IS 14665-1 related electric traction lift guidance
safety.emergency: For a lift emergency, call Tekton service at +91 89254 48131 immediately and do not force the lift doors open.

design.shaftPlanningRule: The website currently states a design-team planning rule where usable cabin width is the clear shaft width minus 370 mm, and cabin depth is the clear shaft depth minus 470 mm.
design.doorOptions: The website currently states centre-opening or two-panel side-opening doors from 600 mm to 1200 mm.
design.designer: Tekton provides a Lift Designer on the website for shaft and cabin planning.

modernisation.description: Tekton provides lift modernisation and retrofitting for existing systems.

quotation.rule: Quotation depends on lift type, capacity, number of stops, shaft dimensions, finishes, travel and site conditions.

faq.answer: Yes. Tekton provides residential and luxury home lifts. The suitable configuration depends on the available shaft, number of stops and site conditions.
Tekton provides commercial passenger elevators. The final configuration depends on capacity, travel, traffic and site conditions.
Tekton provides hospital and stretcher lift solutions. The final cabin and door arrangement depends on the project requirement.
Tekton provides goods and heavy-duty freight lift solutions. Capacity and configuration depend on the intended load and site conditions.
Tekton provides machine-room-less lift configurations. The final arrangement depends on capacity, travel and site conditions.
Tekton provides preventive Annual Maintenance Contracts and emergency support. The exact AMC scope depends on the installed lift and service requirement.
Safety is a core part of Tekton engineering. The website states IS 14665-1 related electric traction lift compliance and Auto Rescue Device-equipped systems.
Shaft requirements depend on the lift capacity, cabin, door arrangement and overall configuration. Tekton can prepare a site-specific design from the available shaft.
Lift capacity depends on the intended use, cabin size, shaft conditions and project requirements.

Tekton uses centre-opening or two-panel side-opening door arrangements. The website currently states door options from 600 mm to 1200 mm, but the final door size depends on the selected lift configuration.
Tekton provides lift modernisation and retrofitting for existing systems. The existing lift and site are assessed before preparing the engineering proposal.
Tekton Elevators has over 20 years of engineering experience and has delivered 300+ installations.
